anchors.event: system_body_targeted:{worldId -1,-1:p1, seed 1600321158, profileId story:tidegarden, profileVersion 1 (story:tidegarden@1), profileHash pf1-eeef3b78, archetype verdant}
Story re-activates at the second hearth at night; the fault is noticed, not announced.
The core's fault record is shown: one bonded cell, degrading, an issued component whose fabrication is not authorized.
The Kestrel Fabricator refuses: pattern not held, source not held locally. The beat advances into ch10-ask.
The source request is committed at the wreck relay after the return crossing and landfall.
The instant reply. Nested inside the ask's own phrase — the relationship IS the meaning.
The player claims the bearing. The rite: the story waits indefinitely and claiming is the commitment.
Launch on the claimed bearing in ch8 grammar; the flight phase leaves the surface.
The edge-on reveal: a line with no body. A veil-clearing, not a crescendo.
The yaw: the line becomes a place; standoff reached. The run's cut line is this frame.
Free play resumes in space, station visible, bearing held; the ch9 close is preserved with a third light added to its geometry.

scoreCues.mixIntent: Dialogue and physical world lead; square fifth and pad remain beneath evidence.
Interaction and physical loss lead; the score makes diminishment audible without masking the command.
The exact line and world remain above a low score floor.
World life, movement, and W-7744 physical evidence remain above the bounded Dorian and quartal bloom.
Repair SFX and hand trace lead; revoice and bed remain subordinate.
Breath, oxygen, water, and interaction remain above low-passed score.
Construction impacts and engine evidence lead; retained score layers never mask prompts.
Hatch and pressure SFX lead; cockpit hum then finds the current root.
Warnings and engine lead, score follows, surface world recedes naturally.
Cockpit and engine lead over a quiet bed and a destination fragment below warnings.
Landing, egress, and ecology remain above the destination bed.
Scanner, relationship, world, and placement SFX lead over bounded notes.
Interior, rest, and living-world sound lead over low counterpoint.
Interior and ecology SFX lead; score under. Entry sits at or below the parked 0.28 so the bed-to-mood handover moves only through the shipped mood-boundary slews. Intensity 0.24.
Caption and SFX lead; the square fifth sits under the triangle rather than over it. Intensity 0.30.
Silence is the content. The beat exits quiet. Intensity 0.22.
Flight SFX lead as shipped ch8. Intensity 0.34 at relay-ask.
No sting, no hit; placement only. Intensity 0.36.
Caption and work-order clear lead. Intensity 0.38.
Engine SFX lead as ch8. Intensity 0.42.
Image leads; score is floor. Intensity 0.36.
Closing caption leads. Intensity 0.44, the run maximum, smaller than A4 by construction and verified against an a4-exhale reference render.
The bed resumes with no click; intensity parks at a named constant. Maximum inter-sample step stays under the click threshold.

Clear Story grade owner and restore the current state-derived world profile.
Clear temporary local-light and exposure owners; retain only committed world, ship, station, and time-of-day sources.
Clear temporary bloom, outline, underwater medium, flight feedback, density ramp, bars, and punctuation owners.
Clear authored overlay and envelope owner; derive steady cue or bed state from committed beat, repair, vehicle, and world identity.
Reconstruct the latest monotonic event, unique-item receipt, vehicle owner, world owner, and safe boundary without manufacturing acceptance.
